ModMetaData.name: Mech Muster
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
Give each mechanitor a desired number of every controllable mech type. Mech Muster assigns newly available, unassigned mechs fairly to eligible mechanitors with deficits while respecting bandwidth, explicit priorities, and existing player assignments.
Open a mechanitor's native Mech Muster command to edit that save's roster. Colonies with several mechanitors get a colony-wide overview before opening an individual roster. Automation can be disabled globally or per mechanitor, and existing overseers and control groups are never changed automatically.
